semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides precision pressure measurement instruments which are crucial for maintaining environmental control in semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
summary: Hwa Chih Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures precision pressure measurement instruments under the SAFE GAUGE brand. Their products, including micro differential pressure gauges and digital pressure instruments, are essential for environmental control in semiconductor fabs and other industrial automation sectors.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan, where it focuses on R&D and production.
